name: lz-scopes
description: Software waveform monitor, vectorscope, histogram and CIE scope in the browser, with RTSP/network inputs via an ffmpeg bridge

scripts.dist:mac: npm run build && node scripts/ffmpeg-fetch.mjs darwin-universal && node scripts/decklink-sdk-fetch.mjs && node scripts/build-helpers.mjs colorsync ndi decklink && electron-builder --config electron-builder.js --mac --universal --publish never
scripts.dist:win: npm run build && node scripts/ffmpeg-fetch.mjs win32-x64 && electron-builder --config electron-builder.js --win --publish never

author: Lars Zumpe
